posts.author: whiteswords12
posts.body:
So I made an event where if actor dies they are removed from party. Is there a way to move the reserve member to that slot?
I have seen scripts to move certain actors to the party or swap the order, but nothing like "the first reserve member slot" to an empty party slot.
Ex: We have 4 party members and 1 died. Looking for a way to bring a reserve member to fill in the empty party.
I am using VisuStella plugins

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Your questions make no sense
If you have only 4 actors in the party, then you have no reserve party.
the reserve party is always actor #5 and higher, with the battleparty being actor #1 to #4.
so where should your replacement actor come from?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Hmmm, VS allows you to choose how many participate in battle. So at the start of battle put into a variable X:
$gameParty.allMembers().filter(actor => !$gameParty.battleMembers().includes(actor))
Then you get the actor you want to add with (first check that there's actors left)
$gameVariables.value(X).shift()
And the id with
.actorId()
(I think LOL)
EDIT: Changed members to allMembers
EDIT2: This was just to get the Id of the next available reserve member. I thought you could switch them with the basic event commands (not sure?)

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
whiteswords12 said:
Im trying to add a reserve member into the party.
Click to expand...
you have a reserve member by having five or more actors in your party, and that is automatic.
just add actors with the change member event command.
obviously you're talking about something else since with a party of four or less actors there is no reserve party - but thzat means whatever you want is NOT a reserve member.
so you need to describe to us what exactly you want - without using the term "reserve member" because the official definition of reserve has absolutely nothing to do with whatever you call a reserve.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
whiteswords12 said:
Because in the party setting you can remove party members and put them in the reserve party.
Click to expand...
but that is NOT the RPG-Maker engine/party system.
you're using a plugin to change how the party system works - in default empty slots are absolutely impossible
so first you need to tell us what that plugin is that you need help  with, complete with a link to the website where you got it from.
then you need to report to a mod so that the mod can move this topic to plugin support as it has nothing to do with MZ support
and then someone who knows the plugin may be able to tell you how to do what you want.
